title: WIA: a bilingual, offline-first Android application for criteria-based impact assessment of water infrastructure projects
description: Bilingual (Arabic/English) offline-first Flutter application for criteria-based screening of the environmental, social, and economic impacts of water infrastructure projects. It implements a Leopold-matrix scoring engine over 38 criteria in three weighted dimensions (environmental 14, social 12, economic 12), aggregates them into a composite project index (40/30/30), and generates severity-tiered mitigation recommendations mapped to the IFC Performance Standards, the World Bank Environmental and Social Framework, and related international frameworks.
